title: Three and Twenty Creek historical station comparison, 2021–2025
issuing_body: South Carolina Department of Environmental Services via Water Quality Portal
publication: Original agency monitoring records; source-bound historical comparison by TokenJunkieLabs, 2026-10-13

grab_sampling.frequency: Original irregular routine sampling; full calendar retained

observation_selection_notes: The full retained result source has 1,588 unique ResultIdentifiers from 126 activities; the exact original-result selector selects 1,502 historical IDs from 120 activities.
Original 2026 SV-833 rows remain retained outside this 2021–2025 selection.
No repeated activity-characteristic values occur in the selected historical originals; each ResultIdentifier contributes separately to its compatible analytical series.
Source Calculated Nitrogen remains separate from same-activity TKN + nitrate/nitrite reconstruction.
Original limit direction, values, units, project, methods and clock/timezone labels are retained.
